Porsche has not announced any official response to the tariffs. The German carmaker shipped additional inventory into the U.S. ahead of the tariffs taken effect, and will honor prices for orders made in March.

### Pricing impact

Porsche confirmed a 1.2%–2.9% price increase for the new year. Orders delivered before January 5th are exempt from the adjustment.

### Production impact

No changes to production or import plans have been announced at this time.

### Manufacturer response [...] Tesla has expressed concerns about the impact of the recent 25% U.S. tariffs on imported vehicles and auto parts. In a letter dated March 11, 2025, Tesla informed the Trump administration that these tariffs could increase production costs for vehicles manufactured in the U.S. The company emphasized its efforts to localize the supply chain but acknowledged continued reliance on global parts sourcing.

### Pricing impact [...] No changes to production or import plans have been announced at this time.

### Manufacturer response

Volkswagen has paused some shipments to the U.S. in response to the tariffs and has guaranteed that prices will remain stable through the month of June to assuage consumer concerns. They have signaled that should the tariffs extend beyond that, they will not be able to absorb all of the added cost.
